title: WhenMeet.me — group scheduling
description: Group meeting scheduler — rank times everyone's free across Google & Outlook, book Meet/Teams.
summary: Group meeting scheduler — rank times everyone's free across Google & Outlook, book Meet/Teams.
offersHint: Group meeting scheduler — rank times everyone's free across Google & Outlook, book Meet/Teams. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://whenmeet.me/mcp

toolsPreview.name: find_common_slots
toolsPreview.description: Rank the best meeting times for the given participants, merging live Google/Microsoft calendar data, hand-marked availability and the heat-map sources. Each participant is filtered (Mon–Fri, waking hours) and scored in their OWN timezone; scores factor in buffer time around existing meetings and prefer sooner slots. Returns up to 8 slots: everyone-free slots first (allFree:true), then — only if there are too few — the best compromise slots (allFree:false) with a freeCount. Defaults to the next 14 days. Requires authentication.

toolsPreview.name: create_meeting
toolsPreview.description: Confirm a meeting: writes the event into the authenticated host’s calendar with an optional Google Meet/Teams link, emails invites with an ICS attachment, and returns the share URL (/m/<id>). Requires authentication.

toolsPreview.name: get_meeting
toolsPreview.description: Read a meeting by its share-link id (the UUID from /m/<id>): time, title, conference URL, host, and any proposed alternate times with their status.

toolsPreview.name: get_meeting_availability
toolsPreview.description: Aggregated group availability for an existing meeting (the symmetric heat-map): per-30-min-slot counts of how many participants are free, plus ranked slots (per-participant timezones, buffer + soonness scoring, allFree:true everyone-free slots and allFree:false compromise slots). Individual calendars are never exposed. No auth needed — the meeting id is the capability.

toolsPreview.name: suggest_time
toolsPreview.description: Propose a different time for an existing meeting on behalf of a guest. The host is notified by email and can accept or decline. Authenticated callers (Bearer PAT) skip the bot challenge; an anonymous caller must pass a Cloudflare Turnstile token in `turnstileToken` (only required when the server is configured with a Turnstile secret).

toolsPreview.name: respond_to_suggestion
toolsPreview.description: Accept or decline a proposed alternate time. Accepting moves the meeting (calendar event included) and re-sends invites. Only the meeting host may call this — requires authentication.

toolsPreview.name: set_manual_availability
toolsPreview.description: Publish hand-marked FREE time slots for an email address (the no-calendar fallback, e.g. Apple iCloud users). Replaces previously marked slots inside the window; the group heat-map updates immediately. Authenticated callers (Bearer PAT) skip the bot challenge; an anonymous caller must pass a Cloudflare Turnstile token in `turnstileToken` (only required when the server is configured with a Turnstile secret).

toolsPreview.name: get_manual_availability
toolsPreview.description: Read previously hand-marked free slots for an email within a window.
